title: Generic finite-time blowup for higher-order area-preserving curvature flows
statement: Let $m\geq0$ and $N_0\geq2$, where $N_0$ is the rotation number of the initial immersed curve. Consider the area-preserving curvature flow of order $m$. **Finite-time blowup conjecture.** Generic initial data lead to finite-time blowup solutions. The source motivates this from the instability of circles when $N_0\geq2$, contrasting with the expected circular behavior of immortal solutions; the genericity assertion and its precise meaning remain open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.06183

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2024).
